components.sub: Open until someone remembers a check.

css: .open-frame { position:absolute; left:1000px; top:190px; width:360px; height:560px; box-sizing:border-box; border:8px solid var(--main); border-radius:10px; background:var(--second) } .open-leaf { position:absolute; left:1008px; top:198px; width:200px; height:544px; box-sizing:border-box; background:var(--tile); border:6px solid var(--main); border-radius:6px; clip-path:polygon(0 0, 100% 34px, 100% 510px, 0 100%) } .open-knob { position:absolute; right:26px; top:50%; width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent) } .open-card { left:1420px; top:340px; width:360px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:22px 28px } .open-card b { display:block; font-size:34px; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap } .open-card span { font-size:26px; color:var(--mute) } .open-tag { left:1600px; top:540px }
